477125.name: Beit Jabad Once - Litvische Shul
477125.note: 'they returned to South America in 5758 (1998) as shluchim in Buenos Aries under Rabbi Grunblatt ... In 5760, a new project came up. Rabbi Stawsky and his wife became the official shluchim of the Beis Chabad of Once, housed in the Litvishe Shul' (Beis Moshiach #895, Sept 2013). 'Asignado a la capital argentina, se le encargó la formación de un Beit Jabad en el barrio Once ... Allí había quedado abandonada una centenaria sinagoga (Litvishe Shil) y el Rabino Stawsky supo crear casi de la nada una hermosa y floreciente comunidad' (Comité Central Israelita del Uruguay, Oct 2012). 5760 ran from Sept 1999 to Sept 2000; it is in Jabad Argentina's first archived list of its houses (Feb 2001). Rabbi Stawsky died on Erev Sukkos 5773 (2012); his son-in-law Rabbi Mendy Kapeluschnik took over with his wife (Periodismo Kosher, Oct 2013).

577218.name: Beit Chabad Congreso - Chabad House for Tourists
577218.note: 'השבוע, חב"ד למטייל בעיר בואנוס איירס שבארגנטינה, בראשות השליח הרב מנחם שרעבי, חוגגים עשור ... בית חב"ד זה שהוקם לפני עשור' (COL, 12 April 2016: the house, founded a decade ago, celebrates ten years). 'In addition to the one in Salvador, new Chabad centers have opened in Cusco, Peru; Buenos Aires and Bariloche, Argentina' (lubavitch.com, 5 Nov 2006, on Chabad houses for Israeli backpackers). Rabbi Menachem Sharabi's first big event was Rosh Hashana in a borrowed old shul, and the house itself came after Simchas Torah (Beis Moshiach #924, April 2014, which says 'in operation for six years'). 'BEIT JABAD LAMETAIEL, Chabad House fot tourist, Adolfo Alsina 1488/92' (Jabad Argentina's list from 2008); now 'Beit Jabad Congreso y para israelíes, Moreno 1276'. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2007-10-09.

5694906.name: Aieka Jewish Teen Center
5694906.note: 'AIEKA: Experiencias y Vivencias. Aieka el centro de actividades para adolescentes de 15 a 18 años realiza un viaje a New York todos los años' (jabad.tv, 12 April 2015, post 9073); with Rabbi Ionatan Sirota (Itón Gadol, Jan 2020). Bartolomé Mitre 4390. Purim 2014: 'Aieka (Circo)' among the stops of a Purim tour of Jabad's houses (Periodismo Kosher, April 2014). No start found; by 2014. Its chabad.org listing went up on 2022-11-08.
